name: draftId
label: Draft ID
help: Draft (szkic) to issue. Irreversible: an invoice accepted by KSeF cannot be withdrawn, only corrected with a correction invoice (faktura korygująca). The key needs the invoices:issue scope.

name: version
label: Draft Version
help: Optional. Map the version from Create Draft or Get Draft so that a retry returns the first result. When empty, the draft's current version is read first; if the draft is already issued, its existing issue is returned instead of issuing again.

name: idempotencyKey
label: Idempotency Key
help: Advanced. Defaults to <draft ID>:<version>, so a retry of the same step returns the first result (replay) instead of a second invoice. Allowed characters: A-Z, a-z, 0-9, ".", "_", ":" and "-", 1–64.
